scope: Proposition 7.3 (Periodic limits and residual local laws) of the manuscript “Conformal universality of bulk Ising correlations under weak interactions” (preprints/Conformal-universality-of-bulk-Ising-correlations-under-weak-interactions-September-23-2026/paper.pdf), one of the manuscripts of result family 218 of openai/math at commit 1581d4cbdd69. The statement is quoted verbatim from the text that pdftotext 24.02.0 (-raw -enc UTF-8) extracts from the PDF (SHA-256 8a815e7845436e07), with whitespace normalised, and was found there under this heading on PDF page 48. Text extraction flattens typeset mathematics (superscripts, subscripts, fractions, large operators, delimiters), so the quote can read differently from the typeset statement and can carry characters with no Unicode meaning; the PDF is authoritative. Finding the quote shows that the manuscript states it, not that it is true. AMVO has checked nothing about this claim.
statement: After one common decrease of the coupling interval, the following hold. 1. At the selected temperature, every bounded observable of finitely many lattice spins has a limit along periodic square boxes as their side tends to infinity. In particular their finite-dimensional laws have a periodic thermodynamic limit at each fixed lattice spacing. 2. Let j → ∞ and N/rj → ∞. For each fixed D < ∞, the expectations of every test of sup norm at most one supported in a square of radius Drj under the residual tilted torus law νN j and the critical nearest-neighbor torus law differ by o(1), uniformly over these tests.
